title: Credited Interest Counted Toward a Raised Business Security Deposit
content:
Credited interest counts toward a raised requirement on a long-held business Security Deposit. The figure that stands against the required amount recorded on the deposit, when the additional amount due is worked out, is the deposit's held basis.

**Held basis.** Held cash is the cash received on the deposit less the cash refunded from it. Whole months are counted from the fully secured date to the payment date, from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting. Payment reversals are those posted on the secured Electric Service Agreement in the 24 months ending on the payment date.

| Time fully secured on the payment date | Payment reversal on the secured agreement in the 24 months | Held basis |
|---|---|---|
| At least 24 whole months | None | Held cash plus all interest credited on the deposit |
| At least 12 but fewer than 24 whole months | None | Held cash plus one half of the interest credited on the deposit |
| Any other case | Any | Held cash alone |

**Becoming held again.** A deposit becomes held on the day the cash received on it reaches its required amount, or on the day an accepted instrument for the full required amount is lodged, except that a deposit returned to assessed by a recalculation becomes held again on the day its held basis reaches the raised required amount, or on the day an accepted instrument for the full raised required amount is lodged.

## Cases (hypothetical deposit: held cash USD 5000.00, interest credited USD 300.00)

| Fully secured date | Payment date | Whole months | Reversal in the 24 months | Held basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2024 | 10 March 2026 | 24 | None | 5300.00 |
| 10 March 2024 | 9 March 2026 | 23 | None | 5150.00 |
| 10 March 2025 | 9 March 2026 | 11 | None | 5000.00 |
| 10 March 2024 | 10 March 2026 | 24 | One | 5000.00 |
